records.rationale: The diff explicitly changes `WEBAPP_URL + `/api/integrations/${appConfig.slug}/callback`` to hardcoded `zoho-bigin` in zoho-bigin/api/add.ts, so the observation is factually accurate. It is not a defect today (slug equals the literal), but it removes a config-driven value and creates a real divergence risk if the slug ever changes, which is a concrete, diff-grounded maintainability concern rather than pure style.

records.issue_text: Refresh-token fetch/update in Salesforce CalendarService runs unconditionally on every connection call instead of only when the access token is expired/invalid, causing unnecessary token refresh and DB writes
records.rationale: The diff adds to SalesforceCalendarService an unconditional `await fetch(...oauth2/token...)` and `prisma.credential.update` on every service instantiation (the code sits directly in the constructor path with no expiry check, unlike other adapters which refresh inside a `refreshAccessToken` callback invoked only when tokens are stale). This causes a network round-trip and DB write per connection call, introduced by this diff, and could also clobber the stored credential key on every call. Real and verifiable from the diff.

records.issue_text: symmetricDecrypt is called with CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY defaulting to empty string instead of failing fast when the key is unset
records.rationale: The handler first checks `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return res.status(403)...`, and APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is defined (in packages/lib/constants.ts in this diff) as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` — so execution can never reach `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")` with the key unset; the empty-string fallback is unreachable defensive code, so no fail-fast gap or defect exists.
